description:
Extract the upstream inline stream loop into a pure state machine: `OctoPi.AI.Providers.OpenAI.Decoder` with `new/1`, `handle/2`, `finalize/1`, `error/3` — matching the Anthropic decoder pattern.

Handles:
- Text deltas (delta.content)
- Reasoning deltas (3 field variants: reasoning_content, reasoning, reasoning_text — use first non-empty)
- Tool calls with index-based multiplexing (delta.tool_calls[] with stream_index)
- Reasoning details (encrypted, matched to tool calls by ID → thought_signature)
- Usage parsing (standard chunk.usage + Moonshot choice.usage fallback; cache read normalization for OpenRouter double-count)
- Stop reason mapping (stop/end→:stop, length→:length, tool_calls/function_call→:tool_use, content_filter/network_error/unknown→:error)
- Block lifecycle (finish current block on type switch)
- Response ID capture

TDD: write fresh tests (upstream tests this inline via mock SDK).

Upstream: openai-completions.ts L198-391, L935-997
Port map: §4
